title: Demucs htdemucs separates a generated drums, bass and vocals mix into four stems
summary: Generated 10 s kick/snare, bass and speech mix: four 44.1 kHz stems of equal length; each estimate correlates most with its own source (margin at least 0.83); SDR drums 8.0, bass 11.1, vocals 16.1 dB; sum residual 20.1 dB. Stems byte-identical across two runs. htdemucs, CPU, arm64.
